caption: The drawing features a rectangular section with a repeating pattern on a blue background. Within each pattern repeat, there is an oval-shaped, white ornamental frame composed of intricate leaf and paisley designs. Inside this frame, there is a countryside scene depicting a person on horseback—dressed in white and green—approaching another standing figure, who is also in green, with a smaller figure next to them. To the left, there is a building resembling a church or cottage, colored in white with a blue roof, set among green trees and bushes. The foreground and background include additional greenery and stylized trees, with some tree branches rendered in light brown. Surrounding the central oval on the outer part of the pattern, floral arrangements with green leaves and pink-peach flowers are distributed, accompanied by smaller white ornamental shapes. The entire patterned drawing is set on a larger, plain beige background with the artist’s signature "N. Camparo" and the year "1937" inscribed at the bottom left, along with a measuring scale at the bottom right.
title: Wall Paper
